title: MZ Simple Save plugin for RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: Psychoholic42
posts.body: I'm looking for an MZ Plugin. I want just a simple save plugin that doesn't show the party faces. I'm working on a game where you have the same party throughout the entire game. I'd like it to have a save that doesn't show the same party for every save file. The only things I want to show are the gameplay time, the area where you saved, and maybe the chapter you are on.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Visu save core let's you not display any faces/Battlers/sprites according to their documentation.
